mira: Quick kitchen note 1: I left a small box of assorted muffins from The Daily Oven on the island (12:30). Theres a sticky that says 3 blueberry, 2 banana, 1 chocolate. Please label anything you put in the fridge.
owen: Thanks mira! Which muffin is which? chocolate always disappears first.
felix: Also heads-up: someone left a jar of something unlabeled in the fridge shelf 2 mid. Its either kimchi or an ambitious salsa. Smells intriguing.
sara: please label it 914 Im not opening mystery jars at 3pm.
mira: @felix i put a tiny note on it saying "fermented experiment?" but no name. if its not claimed by Friday itll go to the communal compost.
own: mini poll: decaf or regular in the office pot tomorrow? react :coffee: for regular, :tea: for decaf, :thumbsup: for both.
felix: :thumbsup: both please. my afternoon crashes are vicious.
sara: :coffee: regular pls.
kitchen-bot: Kitchen Ops reminder: label personal items as "Name / Date / Keep?". Unlabeled perishables older than 96 hours will be removed on Fridays. Also: compost bin moved to under-sink third drawer.
mira: added two oat milk cartons in the fridge (expiry 05/02, labeled). Please only take one each.
own: if anyones running out later i can pick up single-serve almond and oat next errand. leave a :+1: if you want them.
felix: :+1: almond for me.
sara: heads-up for folks using the toaster: crumbs go in the bin, not the sink. The sink trap got clogged last week.
mira: cleaning schedule reminder: if youre the last to leave the kitchen after 6pm, give the counters a once-over. small things make a big difference.
own: someone stole the last labeled jar of jam last week  mystery thief of the 9am breakfast club.
kitchen-bot: Note: replaced hand soap dispenser today. If supplies low ping @facilities.
mira: ok team, thanks for the cleanup help and for leaving space for late lunchers. Muffins are disappearing fast :yum:
